desc: Savage's 110 Varmint model is designed for small distant targets in any condition. It features Savage's AccuFit synthetic stock with five comb riser sizes for the perfect cheek-to-stock weld, four composite inserts to establish your unique length-of-pull, and AccuStock. The AccuStock consists of a rigid rail system firmly embedded in the stock throughout the foreend of the rifle. It also engages the action three dimensionally along its entire length. The 110 Long Range Varmint also features AccuTrigger for flexibility, a button-rifled, heavy carbon steel barrel, soft grip fore-end and pistol grip, and a detachable box magazine.
